chapter: Tape one: clubs, musicians and old friends
title: Haymarket, Salvador Room and the dance halls on Burgundy Street
summary: Lala and the interviewer recall cabarets and dance halls near Canal and Burgundy, and how the murder committee cut out dancing for about three years.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
